Grants and disabled apps are already applied: what is missing from this list you cannot call. The modules available to you are files, notes, calendar, contacts, tasks, deck, talk, people, logs.

- **Arquivos** (`files`): 29 tools — Listar arquivos, Buscar arquivos, Ver árvore de pastas, Criar pasta, Copiar arquivo, Mover arquivo, Mover arquivos em lote, Desfazer operação em lote, Ler arquivo, Editar arquivo, Substituir trecho do arquivo, Baixar arquivo para edição local, Listar versões do arquivo, Ler versão do arquivo, Restaurar versão do arquivo, Ver imagem, Ver várias imagens, Buscar imagens, Ler descrição do arquivo, Editar descrição do arquivo, Listar etiquetas de arquivos, Criar etiqueta de arquivo, Atribuir etiquetas a arquivos, Criar link somente para envio, Listar compartilhamentos, Compartilhar arquivo ou pasta, Parar de compartilhar arquivo ou pasta, Enviar arquivo novo, Criar arquivo de texto.
- **Notas** (`notes`): 7 tools — Listar notas, Buscar notas, Ler nota, Criar nota, Editar nota, Mover nota, Excluir nota.
- **Calendário** (`calendar`): 8 tools — Listar calendários, Listar eventos, Consultar disponibilidade dos calendários, Criar evento, Editar evento, Mover evento para outro calendário, Excluir evento, Transferir evento para calendário de outra pessoa.
- **Contatos** (`contacts`): 6 tools — Listar catálogos de endereços, Buscar contatos, Ler contato, Criar contato, Editar contato, Excluir contato.
- **Tarefas** (`tasks`): 7 tools — Listar agendas de tarefas, Listar tarefas, Ler tarefa, Criar tarefa, Editar tarefa, Concluir tarefa, Excluir tarefa.
- **Deck** (`deck`): 21 tools — Listar quadros do Deck, Listar listas do Deck, Listar cards do Deck, Buscar cartões do Deck, Ler card do Deck, Criar card no Deck, Editar card do Deck, Mover card no Deck, Excluir card do Deck, Acompanhar tarefas do Deck, Criar quadro no Deck, Criar lista no Deck, Excluir lista do Deck, Excluir quadro do Deck, Listar etiquetas do Deck, Alterar etiquetas do cartão do Deck, Listar arquivos do cartão do Deck, Desvincular arquivo do cartão do Deck, Vincular arquivo ao cartão do Deck, Ler comentários do cartão, Publicar comentário no cartão.
- **Talk** (`talk`): 11 tools — Listar conversas do Talk, Ler mensagens do Talk, Pesquisar mensagens do Talk, Ler o contexto de uma mensagem do Talk, Responder no Talk, Anexar arquivo no Talk, Citar arquivo no Talk, Mensagem direta no Talk, Enviar lote no Talk, Criar grupo no Talk, Publicar um resumo no Talk.
- **Pessoas** (`people`): 1 tools — Buscar pessoas.
- **Log do servidor** (`logs`): 2 tools — Ler log do servidor, Analisar log do servidor.

Call this tool again with `module` set to one of those names to get every parameter and every behaviour note of that module, or with `tool` to detail a single tool.

resourceTemplates.title: Arquivos
resourceTemplates.description: Read Nextcloud file content by path.

resourceTemplates.name: notes
resourceTemplates.title: Notas
resourceTemplates.description: Read Nextcloud note content by note ID.

prompts.name: edit_nextcloud_file_locally
prompts.title: Editar um arquivo do Nextcloud localmente
prompts.description: Ensina a baixar um arquivo do Nextcloud, editá-lo com as ferramentas locais e devolvê-lo, sem passar o conteúdo pelo modelo.

prompts.name: create_nextcloud_file

published.name: mcp_guide
published.title: Guia das ferramentas
published.description: Describes the tools this user can call. Without arguments it lists every module available and the tools of each one; with module it details every tool of that module; with tool it details a single tool. Use it before acting with a tool you do not already know. Reads only: it changes nothing.

module.description: Module to detail. Call the guide without arguments to see the modules available to this user.

tool.description: Single tool to detail, by its technical name (for example files_edit). Takes precedence over module.

published.name: files_share
published.title: Compartilhar arquivo ou pasta
published.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Find the account or group id with users_search first (include_groups: true for groups); never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes your public link on an item you own or can re-share (view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; use custom_password for a user-chosen password. The server generates one when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one and none was supplied. Only a generated password is returned, once.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

with.description: Recipient: user:<uid> for a person, group:<gid> for a group, or link for a public link.

permission.description: view to open and download; edit to change too (on a folder: add, change and delete inside it).

expires.description: Last day of access, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later.

note.description: Note shown to the recipient with the share; an empty string removes the current note.

password.description: Public link only: true makes the server generate a new password, which replaces the current one and is shown once in the result. Never choose a password yourself.

custom_password.description: Set or replace the public link password with the exact value chosen by the user. Omit password and omit password_mode or use set. The MCP never returns this value.

password_mode.description: Public link only: preserve the current password, set a generated password, or remove it. Removing is refused when the administrator requires passwords.

expiry_mode.description: Preserve the current expiry, set it with expires, or remove it. Native enforced expiry rules still apply.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm.description: Envie true apenas depois de mostrar ao usuário o plano desta chamada e de ele ter dito explicitamente que sim. Sem isso nada é alterado e a resposta é o plano.

published.name: files_unshare
published.title: Parar de compartilhar arquivo ou pasta
published.description: Stop sharing a file or folder: removes one share you created, so that person, group or public link loses access. Name the share with the shareId from files_list_shares, or with path plus with (user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link). Nothing is deleted: the file or folder and its content stay as they are. You can also remove your own public link on an item you can re-share. A Talk attachment is removed in Talk. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Needs the "share" permission; removing a read link needs "link", and removing an upload-only link needs "upload_link".

shareId.description: The shareId of the share to remove, exactly as files_list_shares returns it (for example ocinternal:123). Use it alone, or use path with with instead.

path.description: File or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf. Use it together with with.

with.description: Whose share to remove from path: user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link. Use it together with path.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm.description: Envie true apenas depois de mostrar ao usuário o plano desta chamada e de ele ter dito explicitamente que sim. Sem isso nada é alterado e a resposta é o plano.

This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Tool guide

Grants and disabled apps are already applied: what is missing from this list you cannot call. The modules available to you are files.

- **Arquivos** (`files`): 2 tools — Compartilhar arquivo ou pasta, Parar de compartilhar arquivo ou pasta.

Call this tool again with `module` set to one of those names to get every parameter and every behaviour note of that module, or with `tool` to detail a single tool.

modules.title: Arquivos
notes: Paths are absolute inside the folder of the user calling and start at "/"; they are never relative and never leave the storage Nextcloud already lets that user reach.

To find something, use files_search for full-text content search when available (or by file name), files_tree for the shape of a folder (depth 5, 2000 entries) and files_list for a single folder. The `access` field of every entry says who owns it and what it allows.
Reorganization is the only way files change places: a copy is capped at 2000 items and 1 GiB, a batch takes at most 200 moves, and nothing overwrites the destination.
Pass `etag` when changing what was just read: a different etag aborts the write instead of dropping the change someone else made in the meantime.

Anything outside the personal folder is refused on a write until the user has been asked and the call repeats with confirm_shared: true. A calendar, a share or a file owned by somebody else is that case.

files_edit, files_replace and files_checkout need versioning on (files_versions). MCP pre-write copies default on in the configured backup folder; administrators may suspend them while Versions is enabled for the actor. Native versioning follows its own policy and does not guarantee recovery. files_checkout hands out short-lived links for local tools instead of passing the content through the model.

files_edit and files_replace change text files only. Use files_checkout for any file type up to the upload limit (docx, xlsx, pdf, images): download, edit locally, upload the whole file back. A scanned PDF is regenerated by the client from what it read, never edited byte by byte.

To create a NEW file generated locally (docx, xlsx, pdf, image, any type), use files_upload: confirm it, then send the bytes with curl -sS -T /tmp/file -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "$UPLOAD_URL" to the single-use uploadUrl it returns (15 minutes, the same limit as files_checkout). For a small text file (.md, .txt, .csv, .json, .html, .xml, .yaml) use files_create with the content inline, up to 1 MB. Neither ever overwrites a file with content: to replace an existing file use files_checkout. The folder must already exist (files_mkdir).

files_read and files_version_read of a PDF or image with no text return text_layer: false and a notice instead of an error: the file is a scan. If the Workflow OCR app is active it recognises the text in the background (by the administrator's rule) and writes it into the PDF as a new version, so read again later; otherwise view the page as an image with the image tools.

There is no delete: files_undo_batch is the way back from files_move_batch, and files_version_restore writes the content of a stored version back over the file, applying the administrator backup setting.

files_share shares a file or folder of yours with a person (with: user:<uid>) or a group (group:<gid>); find the id with users_search (include_groups: true for groups) and never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share; the plan shows before → after, including a re-share right a web-made share loses. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. with: "link" is the public link of the file (needs the "link" permission). For a read or upload link, use custom_password only for a value supplied by the user. A generated password is shown once in the confirmed result. Confirm with the plan_state of the plan: when the share changed in the meantime, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan to show again.

files_list_shares shows only shares you created. On items shared with you, you can manage your own public links when Nextcloud permits re-sharing and downloads. A password is never shown, only hasPassword. A room share is a Talk attachment and is removed in Talk. Sharing with people or groups needs the "share" permission and public links the separate "link" permission, both granted by the administrator.

files_unshare removes one share you created (by the shareId of files_list_shares, or by path plus with); the plan says who loses access, and the file itself is never touched. It cannot remove what somebody else shared or an internal share on a received item. Remove Talk attachments in Talk. Confirm with the plan_state of the plan, as for files_share.

tools.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Find the account or group id with users_search first (include_groups: true for groups); never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes your public link on an item you own or can re-share (view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; use custom_password for a user-chosen password. The server generates one when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one and none was supplied. Only a generated password is returned, once.

contents.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Tool guide

Grants and disabled apps are already applied: what is missing from this list you cannot call. The modules available to you are files.

- **Arquivos** (`files`): 2 tools — Compartilhar arquivo ou pasta, Parar de compartilhar arquivo ou pasta.

Call this tool again with `module` set to one of those names to get every parameter and every behaviour note of that module, or with `tool` to detail a single tool.

raw.name: files_list
raw.description: List files and folders from a user Nextcloud directory.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

raw.name: files_search
raw.description: Search files by name or indexed content in the user folder on Nextcloud; when permitted, stored file descriptions are searched too.

query.description: Search term to find in file names or indexed content, and in stored file descriptions when permitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 25).

mode.description: Search mode: "auto" uses full-text content search when available, falls back to name search, and includes matching stored descriptions when permitted. Results report content_and_description or name_and_description when descriptions are searched; "name" searches only file names.

raw.name: files_tree
raw.description: List the file tree of a folder, with the owner of each item and capacity limits. Use to plan a reorganization without one call per folder. Enforces depth and entry limits, and warns when truncated.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

raw.name: files_mkdir
raw.description: Create a folder, including intermediate levels when missing. Refuses if destination already exists and never deletes existing contents. If destination is outside your personal folder, ask the user first and retry with confirm_shared.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_copy
raw.description: Copy a file or folder to another path, creating a new node with a new id. Never overwrites the destination. The copy is an independent node: does not preserve source id, versions, or shares. Capped at 2000 items and 1073741824 bytes, measured before copying. If source or destination is outside your personal folder, ask the user first and retry with confirm_shared.

from.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

etag.description: Previously read ETag; if it differs, nothing is written

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_move
raw.description: Move or rename a file or folder within the same file area, without overwriting the destination. Reports id before and after, as well as version and share counts when corresponding apps are enabled. Does not move across different storages: there Nextcloud treats it as a copy and the id changes. If source or destination is outside your personal folder, ask the user first and retry with confirm_shared.

from.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

etag.description: Previously read ETag; if it differs, nothing is written

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_move_batch
raw.description: Move several files and create folders, in the given order. Without confirm: true writes nothing and returns the full plan: what would succeed, what conflicts, what Nextcloud denies, what belongs to someone else, and which folders would be created. With confirm: true it executes in order, creates the folders beforehand and returns a batch_id to undo with files_undo_batch. An item failing midway halts the batch: items already moved remain recorded and can be undone, and unattempted items are returned as not_attempted.

moves.description: Moves in the order they will be executed.

from.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_undo_batch
raw.description: Undo a files_move_batch, returning each node to its source path in reverse order. Before making any changes checks the whole batch: if any item is no longer what the batch placed at destination, if the source path is already occupied, or if permissions changed, nothing is undone and the response identifies the blocking item. Removes only empty folders that the batch itself created; a folder with content is preserved and listed in kept_dirs.

raw.name: files_read
raw.description: Read the text of a file from Nextcloud (plain text/markdown directly; PDF/DOCX/ODT via text extraction).

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

raw.name: files_edit
raw.description: Replace the content of an existing text file and return the diff. Before writing, requires active versioning. MCP copies follow the administrator backup setting. If the file is outside your personal folder, only write after asking the user and retrying the call with confirm_shared. Never creates, moves, or deletes files.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

content.description: Complete new content (UTF-8)

etag.description: Previously read ETag; if it differs, nothing is written

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_replace
raw.description: Replace a unique snippet of an existing text file and return the diff. The specified snippet must appear exactly once. Before writing, requires active versioning and applies the administrator backup setting. If the file is outside your personal folder, only write after asking the user and retrying the call with confirm_shared.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

old.description: Snippet to replace; must appear exactly once in the file

new.description: Replacement text for the specified snippet

etag.description: Previously read ETag; if it differs, nothing is written

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_checkout
raw.description: Provide temporary download and upload links to edit any file type (document, spreadsheet, PDF, image) with local tools (curl) without passing content through the model, up to the upload limit. Upload raw bytes with curl -T /tmp/file -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "$UPLOAD_URL". A text file can also be edited directly with files_edit or files_replace. Links are valid for 5 to 15 minutes, single-use, and bound to you, the file, and current ETag: if the file changes before upload, nothing is written. Upload follows the same administrator backup setting as files_edit. If the file is outside your personal folder, only issue links after asking the user and retrying with confirm_shared.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

etag.description: Previously read ETag; if it differs, nothing is written

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_versions_list
raw.description: List versions of a file from the Versions app, from newest to oldest.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

raw.name: files_version_read
raw.description: Read the text of a previous file version, with the same limit and text extraction as files_read.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

version.description: Version identifier, as returned by files_versions_list

raw.name: files_version_restore
raw.description: Restore a previous file version. Pre-write copies use the configured MCP backup folder unless suspended by the administrator while native versioning is enabled. If the file is outside your personal folder, restore only after asking the user and retrying with confirm_shared.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

version.description: Version identifier, as returned by files_versions_list

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_image_view
raw.description: Fetch a reduced preview of an image file as inline image bytes, so the model can actually see it. Reads only; honors the user folder and permissions. Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, GIF, TIFF and the first page of a PDF when the Nextcloud server has a preview provider for the format. The returned image is JPEG/PNG/WebP under a server-wide byte limit: if the preview is still too big the max dimension is reduced until it fits.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

max_size.description: Maximum width or height of the returned preview, in pixels (256-2048, default 1568)

raw.name: files_images_view
raw.description: Fetch several image previews in a single call. Pass either paths (up to 6 items) or folder (plus an optional limit) to pick the most recently modified images under that folder. The total image bytes stay under a server-wide budget; images that do not fit are reported as skipped with the reason, so the agent knows what was left out.

folder.description: Folder to look in, e.g. /Photos; omit to search the whole user folder

max_size.description: Maximum width or height of the returned preview, in pixels (256-2048, default 1568)

raw.name: files_image_search
raw.description: Search image files in the user folder, optionally filtered by name query, folder, modification date range or system tag name (the tag names created by the Recognize app count too). Results are listed newest first and only contain the file metadata; use files_image_view to fetch bytes.

query.description: Optional name substring, e.g. "beach"

folder.description: Folder to look in, e.g. /Photos; omit to search the whole user folder

modified_after.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, only images modified at or after this moment are returned

modified_before.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, only images modified at or before this moment are returned

tag.description: System tag name (case-sensitive), including automatic tags created by the Recognize app

raw.name: files_get_image_description
raw.description: Read the saved description or summary of any file in Files, with embedded description fallback for images.

path.description: Path relative to your Files root.

raw.name: files_set_image_description
raw.description: Set a description or summary for any file in Nextcloud Files metadata after preview and confirmation.

path.description: Path relative to your Files root.

description.description: Plain-text description or summary; an empty string explicitly clears any embedded image fallback.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_list_tags
raw.description: List public, assignable native file tags, optionally including tags on one accessible file.

raw.name: files_create_tag
raw.description: Create or reuse a public, assignable native file tag.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

raw.name: files_set_tags
raw.description: Add and/or remove public, assignable native tags on accessible files.

items.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

raw.name: files_create_upload_link
raw.description: Create or update a password-protected public folder link that lets visitors create files only. Visitors cannot read, list, update or delete existing content. Needs the separate "upload_link" permission.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

expires.description: Last day of access, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later.

expiry_mode.description: Preserve the current expiry, set it with expires, or remove it. Native enforced expiry rules still apply.

custom_password.description: Set or replace the public link password with the exact value chosen by the user. Omit password and omit password_mode or use set. The MCP never returns this value.

password_mode.description: A password is always required. Preserve the current password, or set a newly generated one that is shown once.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

raw.name: files_list_shares
raw.description: List the shares you created: with a path, your shares on that file or folder, including your public links on items you can re-share; without one, every share you created, 50 per page with offset. Each item has shareId, type (user, group, link or room), with (id and display name), permission (view, edit or custom), reshare, expires, hasPassword, url (links only; null for a folder link while files are excluded from MCP access), removable and path. Passwords are never returned. A room share is a Talk attachment: it is listed with removable: false and is removed in Talk.

path.description: File or folder whose shares to list, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf. Omit to list every share you created.

offset.description: Shares to skip when listing without path; use the nextOffset of the previous page.

raw.name: files_share
raw.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Find the account or group id with users_search first (include_groups: true for groups); never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes your public link on an item you own or can re-share (view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; use custom_password for a user-chosen password. The server generates one when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one and none was supplied. Only a generated password is returned, once.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

with.description: Recipient: user:<uid> for a person, group:<gid> for a group, or link for a public link.

permission.description: view to open and download; edit to change too (on a folder: add, change and delete inside it).

expires.description: Last day of access, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later.

note.description: Note shown to the recipient with the share; an empty string removes the current note.

password.description: Public link only: true makes the server generate a new password, which replaces the current one and is shown once in the result. Never choose a password yourself.

custom_password.description: Set or replace the public link password with the exact value chosen by the user. Omit password and omit password_mode or use set. The MCP never returns this value.

password_mode.description: Public link only: preserve the current password, set a generated password, or remove it. Removing is refused when the administrator requires passwords.

expiry_mode.description: Preserve the current expiry, set it with expires, or remove it. Native enforced expiry rules still apply.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

raw.name: files_unshare
raw.description: Stop sharing a file or folder: removes one share you created, so that person, group or public link loses access. Name the share with the shareId from files_list_shares, or with path plus with (user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link). Nothing is deleted: the file or folder and its content stay as they are. You can also remove your own public link on an item you can re-share. A Talk attachment is removed in Talk. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Needs the "share" permission; removing a read link needs "link", and removing an upload-only link needs "upload_link".

shareId.description: The shareId of the share to remove, exactly as files_list_shares returns it (for example ocinternal:123). Use it alone, or use path with with instead.

path.description: File or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf. Use it together with with.

with.description: Whose share to remove from path: user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link. Use it together with path.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

raw.name: files_upload
raw.description: Create a NEW file of any type (docx, xlsx, pdf, image, zip) that you generated locally, without passing its content through the model. Without confirm: true it returns the plan; with confirm: true it returns uploadUrl, a single-use link valid for 15 minutes and bound to you and this path. Send the bytes with curl -sS -T /tmp/file -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "$UPLOAD_URL"; the answer carries path, size, etag and fileId. Never overwrites a file with content: an existing name is refused, so use files_checkout to replace an existing file. For a small text file use files_create. The folder must exist (files_mkdir creates it); outside your personal folder ask the user and retry with confirm_shared.

path.description: Full path of the new file, including its name, e.g. /Reports/Report.docx

size.description: Size of the local file in bytes, optional: a size over the upload limit is refused before any link is issued

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: files_create
raw.description: Create a NEW small text file with its content inline: .md, .txt, .csv, .json, .html, .xml, .yaml, .yml, up to 1 MB of UTF-8. Never overwrites a file with content: an existing name is refused (use files_edit or files_checkout to change it). For any other type or a larger file use files_upload. The folder must exist (files_mkdir creates it); outside your personal folder ask the user and retry with confirm_shared.

path.description: Full path of the new file, including its name, e.g. /Reports/Report.docx

content.description: Complete text of the new file, up to 1 MB of UTF-8

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the file is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: notes_list
raw.description: Lists the notes (Notes app) of the user.

raw.name: notes_search
raw.description: Searches notes by title and content (Markdown).

query.description: Search term to find in note title or content.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (1-100, default 20).

category.description: Optional category (subfolder) to limit search to; empty for all notes.

raw.name: notes_read
raw.description: Reads the content of a note by id.

raw.name: notes_create
raw.description: Creates a note; never overwrites an existing one.

content.description: Content in Markdown.

category.description: Category (subfolder); empty for the root.

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the note is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: notes_edit
raw.description: Changes the content and/or the title of a note.

append.description: Text added at the end, on a new line.

old.description: Passage to replace; must appear exactly once.

new.description: Text that replaces old.

content.description: New complete content; mutually exclusive with append and old/new.

etag.description: ETag read before; when it differs, nothing is changed.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the note is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: notes_move
raw.description: Moves a note to another category.

category.description: Destination category; empty for the root.

etag.description: ETag read before; when it differs, nothing is changed.

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the note is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: notes_delete
raw.description: Deletes a note to the Nextcloud trash bin, where it can be restored.

etag.description: ETag read before; when it differs, nothing is changed.

confirm_shared.description: Required only when the note is outside your personal folder (shared, team folder, or external storage). Send only after confirming with the user.

raw.name: calendar_list_calendars
raw.description: Lists calendars visible to the user.

raw.name: calendar_list_events
raw.description: Lists events in a time range (default: next 7 days).

calendar.description: calendar path (optional)

from.description: start ISO date

raw.name: calendar_check_availability
raw.description: Check busy times, conflicts and free intervals in accessible calendars

from.description: inclusive start ISO date or timestamp

to.description: exclusive end ISO date or timestamp

calendars.description: Calendar paths from calendar_list_calendars; omit to check all visible calendars.

min_duration_minutes.description: Minimum length of returned free ranges, in minutes.

raw.name: calendar_create_event
raw.description: Creates a simple event (no recurrence) in a writable calendar. Attendees are Nextcloud account IDs; call users_search first if you are not sure of someone's ID. This call may send invitations to other people. If the resource belongs to someone else, the agent MUST ask the user before sending confirm_shared: true. First returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user and wait for explicit approval; then repeat the same arguments with confirm=true, adding the etag returned in the plan when it has one.

calendar.description: calendar path, as returned by calendar_list_calendars

summary.description: event title

start.description: start: YYYY-MM-DD (all-day) or ISO with Z/offset

end.description: exclusive end, in the same format as start

attendees.description: Nextcloud account IDs (not emails); if you are not sure of someone's ID, call users_search first. Replaces the attendee list.

send_invitations.description: true delivers the invitation to Nextcloud scheduling; email depends on server settings and does not confirm receipt

confirm_shared.description: set to true only after the user confirms changing a calendar that belongs to someone else

raw.name: calendar_update_event
raw.description: Updates title, location, description, dates, or attendees (account IDs; call users_search first if unsure) of an event. Recurrent series dates cannot be changed. This call may send invitations to other people. Attendees are only notified with send_invitations: true, depending on server configuration; sending does not confirm receipt. If the resource belongs to someone else, the agent MUST ask the user before sending confirm_shared: true. First returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user and wait for explicit approval; then repeat the same arguments with confirm=true, adding the etag returned in the plan when it has one.

calendar.description: calendar path, as returned by calendar_list_calendars

summary.description: new title

start.description: new start: YYYY-MM-DD (all-day) or ISO with Z/offset

end.description: new exclusive end

attendees.description: Nextcloud account IDs (not emails); if you are not sure of someone's ID, call users_search first. Replaces the attendee list.

send_invitations.description: true delivers the invitation to Nextcloud scheduling; email depends on server settings and does not confirm receipt

etag.description: expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed

duedate.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS] in the account timezone, or a timestamp with Z or an explicit offset (±HH:MM). Send null to remove it.

Preview first, repeat plan_state and the exact file_state receipt with confirm:true. file_state is accepted only on confirm; invalid/replayed/stale receipt, hidden and nonexistent association share one refusal. A confirmed absent association is a no-op only with valid original HMAC and the original file still visible. Never unlinks invisible files, legacy deck_file or folders. Available on Nextcloud 32 through 35. An editor of the card can unlink a visible association created by someone else. A folder you can already see, and an archived card or board, are refused in plain language.

raw.name: deck_link_card_file

The plan names the file, its owner, whether it is a reshare, the current recipient total, a limited name list and the shares you created. Refuses Guests, group-only sharing, a group or team on the board when group sharing is off, mandatory internal expiry, a recipient that is not a fully resolved local user, group or team, folders, archived cards or boards, and any failure to read those facts. Available on Nextcloud 32 through 35. No upload, copy or file deletion. Native sharing hooks and notifications may run; optional default internal expiry does not apply to this Deck share. Does not suggest changing a sharing policy or signing in another way. A policy enabled later, a membership change, and the gap between the last check and the native share are outside this check: there is no continuous protection and no automatic revocation.

fileId.description: Id of the existing visible File in your Files scope. Folders are refused.

confirm_shared.description: Set to true only after the user confirms linking a shared file or changing another user's board.

raw.name: talk_list_conversations
raw.description: Lists the Talk conversations the authenticated user takes part in, with the number of unread messages. It changes no state: it does not mark anything as read, does not touch notifications and does not touch activity.

Each page is ordered oldest-to-newest and includes messages plus next_before_message_id. Start without before_message_id; use the returned next_before_message_id as the exclusive before_message_id for older history. The cursor is null when no older page remains. Use a message id in reply_to to answer, and attachmentId to cite an attachment.

raw.name: talk_search_messages
raw.description: Searches message text in one conversation the authenticated user can read. Results are ordered newest-to-oldest and include messages, next_offset, and has_more. Pass next_offset for the next bounded page; if pagination_limited is true, the maximum offset was reached. Search does not mark messages as read, change notifications or record activity.

raw.name: talk_read_message_context
raw.description: Reads a bounded window around one message in the same conversation, with up to before_limit earlier messages and after_limit later messages. The anchor must belong to the conversation. Results are ordered oldest-to-newest and include has_more_before and has_more_after. Reading does not mark messages as read, change notifications or record activity. Each returned text is capped at 4,000 characters and marked with text_truncated when needed.

raw.name: talk_reply
raw.description: Sends a message in a conversation, optionally quoting another message of the same conversation with reply_to. To point at a Deck card or a calendar event, send reference with {type: deck_card, card_id, board_id optional} or {type: calendar_event, calendar (the path reported by calendar_list_calendars), uid}: the server checks that the user can access the item and appends the title and the link of the item to the text, and the draft already shows the final text. Anyone in the conversation who cannot access the item will see the title and the link, so only reference what the user approves showing. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the approval itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

raw.name: talk_attach_file
raw.description: Shares into the conversation a file that already exists in the user's Nextcloud; Talk itself publishes the attachment card. When message is filled in, it is sent as a second text message right after the attachment, and messageId carries the id of that message. If the file is already shared in this conversation, nothing is published. If the share is created but the caption fails, the answer is not an error: it comes with attachmentId and captionSent false plus the instruction to send the caption with talk_reply, because the attachment is already in the chat. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the approval itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

raw.name: talk_quote_file
raw.description: Publishes a message citing an attachment already present in the conversation, identified by attachment_id, with an optional caption in message. Use the attachmentId (the numeric share id) that talk_attach_file or talk_read_messages returned for that attachment, not the id of the message that carries it. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the approval itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

raw.name: talk_message_user
raw.description: Sends a direct message to a user, without needing the conversation token: send user with the account id (if you are not sure of it, call users_search first). The direct conversation is created when it does not exist yet, the way Talk does when a chat is started; the preview never creates anything. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the approval itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

raw.name: talk_send_batch
raw.description: Sends several messages at once in the same conversation, each one optionally quoting an earlier message: send messages with the list of objects {message, reply_to}. Use it when the answer is a sequence of short messages (one per item of a list, for instance), and prefer talk_reply when it is a single message. The conversation and the quotes are checked before anything is sent; sending happens item by item and each item is reported in sent or failed, without repeating what was already published. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, s the confirmation covers the whole batch, not each item, and the confirmation itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

raw.name: talk_create_group
raw.description: Creates a group conversation in Talk, with the authenticated user as its owner: send name with the name of the group and participants with the list of accounts to invite (optional). Every guest goes through the same visibility rule as a direct message, and all of them appear in the preview before any invitation. Creating a group invites people and this tool does not undo an invitation once it has been made, so the operation requires the talk.create grant and an explicit approval. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and creates nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the confirmation covers the whole group, name and guests together, and it itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client. Whoever does not approve does not get an empty group in the list: the room is only created by the approved call. Anyone in the conversation who cannot access the item will see the title and the link, so only reference what the user approves showing. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and writes nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the approval itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client.

The conversation and the quotes are checked before anything is sent; sending happens item by item and each item is reported in sent or failed, without repeating what was already published. tools.description: Creates a group conversation in Talk, with the authenticated user as its owner: send name with the name of the group and participants with the list of accounts to invite (optional). Every guest goes through the same visibility rule as a direct message, and all of them appear in the preview before any invitation. Creating a group invites people and this tool does not undo an invitation once it has been made, so the operation requires the talk.create grant and an explicit approval. Before sending, the agent MUST call the tool without confirm, which returns a plan and creates nothing, show that plan to the user and ask whether they really want it; only after an explicit yes repeat the same call with confirm: true and the same arguments. Nothing is kept on the server: there is no approval id, no token and no expiry, so the confirmation covers the whole group, name and guests together, and it itself depends on the agent showing the plan and on the user saying yes in the client. Whoever does not approve does not get an empty group in the list: the room is only created by the approved call. The invitations are made one by one after the creation: whoever joined comes in participants and whoever Talk refused comes in invitations_failed, with the id of each one; in that case the group already exists, so do not repeat the call, tell the user who was left out.

content.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Tool guide

Grants and disabled apps are already applied: what is missing from this list you cannot call. The modules available to you are files, notes, calendar, contacts, tasks, deck, talk, people.

- **Archivos** (`files`): 10 tools — Listar archivos, Buscar archivos, Ver árbol de carpetas, Leer archivo, Listar versiones del archivo, Leer versión del archivo, Ver imagen, Ver varias imágenes, Buscar imágenes, Listar recursos compartidos.
- **Notas** (`notes`): 3 tools — Listar notas, Buscar notas, Leer nota.
- **Calendario** (`calendar`): 2 tools — Listar calendarios, Listar eventos.
- **Contactos** (`contacts`): 3 tools — Listar libretas de direcciones, Buscar contactos, Leer contacto.
- **Tareas** (`tasks`): 3 tools — Listar calendarios de tareas, Listar tareas, Leer tarea.
- **Deck** (`deck`): 7 tools — Listar tableros de Deck, Listar listas de Deck, Listar tarjetas de Deck, Leer tarjeta de Deck, Seguimiento de tareas de Deck, Listar etiquetas de Deck, Listar archivos de la tarjeta de Deck.
- **Talk** (`talk`): 2 tools — Listar conversaciones de Talk, Leer mensajes de Talk.
- **Personas** (`people`): 1 tools — Buscar personas.

Call this tool again with `module` set to one of those names to get every parameter and every behaviour note of that module, or with `tool` to detail a single tool.

structuredContent.language_note: This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

modules.title: Archivos
notes: Paths are absolute inside the folder of the user calling and start at "/"; they are never relative and never leave the storage Nextcloud already lets that user reach.

To find something, use files_search for full-text content search when available (or by file name), files_tree for the shape of a folder (depth 5, 2000 entries) and files_list for a single folder. The `access` field of every entry says who owns it and what it allows.
Reorganization is the only way files change places: a copy is capped at 2000 items and 1 GiB, a batch takes at most 200 moves, and nothing overwrites the destination.
Pass `etag` when changing what was just read: a different etag aborts the write instead of dropping the change someone else made in the meantime.

Anything outside the personal folder is refused on a write until the user has been asked and the call repeats with confirm_shared: true. A calendar, a share or a file owned by somebody else is that case.

files_edit, files_replace and files_checkout need versioning on (files_versions). MCP pre-write copies default on in the configured backup folder; administrators may suspend them while Versions is enabled for the actor. Native versioning follows its own policy and does not guarantee recovery. files_checkout hands out short-lived links for local tools instead of passing the content through the model.

files_edit and files_replace change text files only. Use files_checkout for any file type up to the upload limit (docx, xlsx, pdf, images): download, edit locally, upload the whole file back. A scanned PDF is regenerated by the client from what it read, never edited byte by byte.

To create a NEW file generated locally (docx, xlsx, pdf, image, any type), use files_upload: confirm it, then send the bytes with curl -sS -T /tmp/file -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "$UPLOAD_URL" to the single-use uploadUrl it returns (15 minutes, the same limit as files_checkout). For a small text file (.md, .txt, .csv, .json, .html, .xml, .yaml) use files_create with the content inline, up to 1 MB. Neither ever overwrites a file with content: to replace an existing file use files_checkout. The folder must already exist (files_mkdir).

files_read and files_version_read of a PDF or image with no text return text_layer: false and a notice instead of an error: the file is a scan. If the Workflow OCR app is active it recognises the text in the background (by the administrator's rule) and writes it into the PDF as a new version, so read again later; otherwise view the page as an image with the image tools.

There is no delete: files_undo_batch is the way back from files_move_batch, and files_version_restore writes the content of a stored version back over the file, applying the administrator backup setting.

files_share shares a file or folder of yours with a person (with: user:<uid>) or a group (group:<gid>); find the id with users_search (include_groups: true for groups) and never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share; the plan shows before → after, including a re-share right a web-made share loses. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. with: "link" is the public link of the file (needs the "link" permission). For a read or upload link, use custom_password only for a value supplied by the user. A generated password is shown once in the confirmed result. Confirm with the plan_state of the plan: when the share changed in the meantime, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan to show again.

files_list_shares shows only shares you created. On items shared with you, you can manage your own public links when Nextcloud permits re-sharing and downloads. A password is never shown, only hasPassword. A room share is a Talk attachment and is removed in Talk. Sharing with people or groups needs the "share" permission and public links the separate "link" permission, both granted by the administrator.

files_unshare removes one share you created (by the shareId of files_list_shares, or by path plus with); the plan says who loses access, and the file itself is never touched. It cannot remove what somebody else shared or an internal share on a received item. Remove Talk attachments in Talk. Confirm with the plan_state of the plan, as for files_share.

modules.title: Notas
notes: A note is addressed by the `id` notes_list or notes_search returns, not by its title; the title is the file name and the category is the subfolder it sits in.
Use notes_search to find notes by keyword in title or Markdown content.
notes_create never overwrites: when the title is taken in that category it picks a free name, and the response says which name it used.
notes_delete only deletes where the Nextcloud trash bin takes the note back; anywhere else it refuses instead of removing it for good.
Notes are capped at 1048576 bytes read or written, and a title at 200 characters.
notes_edit accepts only one of content, append or old/new; append adds a line and old/new replaces one unique passage. Partial edits need the etag and plan_state from a fresh plan when confirmed.
Pass `etag` to make a change fail instead of overwriting somebody else's version of the same note.
Some notes or categories may be hidden by administrator policy and will appear as if they do not exist.

tools.title: Listar notas

modules.title: Calendario
notes: Calendars are addressed by path: calendar_list_calendars gives the paths of this user. Events are addressed by uid, and calendar_list_events gives the uids of a period.

calendar_check_availability reads busy intervals and free ranges in an explicit UTC window of at most 31 days. It checks at most 20 visible calendars and returns no event titles. Private or unreadable event data, a scan limit, or any incomplete scan makes the whole answer unavailable rather than claiming a time is free.

Every write answers with a plan first: what it would change, the etag of the object as it is now, and which invitations would go out. Nothing is written until the very same call is repeated with confirm: true, so show the plan to the user and wait for an explicit yes.

The plan of a create, update (when the time or the guests change), move or transfer can carry warnings: a collision with another event of the target calendar, a participant who is busy or whose agenda could not be checked, and a calendar that is not shared with the participants. Each warning has a type (collision, busy, unverifiable, calendarNotShared) and a message to read to the user. They never block: tell the user and repeat the call with confirm: true only if the answer is still yes. When sharedCalendars lists calendars the participants already see and suggestedCalendar is set, offer it; when there are several, ask the user which one to use and repeat the call with that calendar. Other people's appointments are only ever reported as busy, never with their content. When an update moves an event, the event's own slot is left out of the availability check of the guests it already has (their copy of the invitation would otherwise make them busy); the collision check always leaves the event itself out. An appointment of a guest sitting entirely inside the old slot is not reported.
Dates and times arrive as they will be stored, and are read back in the timezone of the account; a recurring event is expanded into its occurrences before it reaches the user.

send_invitations hands the invitation to the CalDAV scheduling of the server. The plan and the result say whether the server has e-mail invitations switched on (imipEnabled); when it is off, say so to the user instead of claiming an e-mail was sent.
A calendar owned by somebody else (a share) needs confirm_shared after asking the user, and a transfer moves the event there and removes it from here.
A deleted event goes to the Nextcloud trash bin of the calendar; with retention at 0 the deletion is refused rather than permanent.
The writing tools appear only when the administrator granted them to this user; a module showing reads only means the writing grants are off.

tools.name: calendar_list_calendars
tools.title: Listar calendarios
tools.description: Lists calendars visible to the user.

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.title: Listar eventos
tools.description: Lists events in a time range (default: next 7 days).

modules.title: Contactos
notes: List address books first; your own and shared address books are exposed, plus the read-only accounts catalog when the admin allows it. Searching without an address book also covers the accounts of the instance (colleagues, with a term of at least 2 characters, following the admin user-enumeration settings); each account result has accountId, the ID to use for invitations. Use users_search to look for accounts only. Account contacts can never be created, edited or deleted.
Search an address book to obtain contact object URIs, then read a contact before editing it. Unknown vCard properties are preserved; the preview includes every property before and after.

Writes first show a plan without changing anything. Wait for an explicit yes, repeat with confirm=true, and acknowledge another owner with confirm_shared=true. The optional etag prevents overwriting a newer edit.

Contact deletion is PERMANENT in Nextcloud: there is no contact trash. After confirmation, a verified full .vcf copy is saved under Contacts in the configured backup folder before native CardDAV DELETE. Backup failure prevents deletion; the result gives the backup path. Import the .vcf through Contacts to recover it.
These tools are hidden when the Contacts app is disabled. Writing grants start disabled.

tools.name: contacts_list_addressbooks
tools.title: Listar libretas de direcciones
tools.description: List your own and shared address books plus, when the admin exposes it, the read-only accounts catalog of the instance.

tools.name: contacts_search_contacts
tools.title: Buscar contactos
tools.description: Search contacts by name, email, phone or organization in one address book or, when "addressbook" is omitted, in all of them including the read-only accounts of the instance (colleagues). Account results carry accountId, the user ID to use for invitations, attendees, Deck and Talk. An empty query lists personal contacts only; accounts need a search term of at least 2 characters.

tools.name: contacts_read_contact
tools.title: Leer contacto
tools.description: Read a contact including all vCard properties and its ETag. A contact of the accounts catalog returns only its public fields and accountId, without vCard or ETag.

modules.title: Tareas
notes: Task calendars support VTODO. These tools require the Tasks app and core CalDAV. List task calendars before addressing a task by UID.

Undated tasks are included. Completed tasks are hidden by default in listings. Recurring tasks can be read; changing recurring tasks or tasks with participants is refused to protect their series and scheduling.

Task categories are free text, as in the Tasks app. On create and edit, a categories list replaces all existing categories, [] clears them and omitting the field preserves them. tasks_list_tasks can filter by one category, ignoring case.

Subtasks link to their parent by UID (RELATED-TO), as in the Tasks app, and every task returns its parent UID or null. On create and edit, parent sets it, null makes the task top-level and omitting it preserves it; the parent must be a visible task of the same calendar and cannot be the task or one of its subtasks, and no task may end up deeper than 64 levels, the moved subtasks included. tasks_list_tasks with parent lists the direct subtasks. Deleting or completing a parent does not change its subtasks. The hierarchy is checked on the state read when the plan is built and again at confirmation; confirmed MCP writes that set a parent in one calendar run one at a time (they are refused when the file locking of the server is disabled), but other clients can still change related tasks at the same moment, and an answer with a warning says that the parent chain then loops.
Private and confidential tasks in shared calendars are hidden. Writable shares require confirm_shared=true after showing the owner notice.
Every write starts with a before/after plan. Wait for explicit approval before confirm=true; the optional etag checks for concurrent edits. Writing grants start disabled.
Deletion uses the native calendar trash and is refused when calendar retention is zero. The result confirms recovery through the calendar trash.

tools.name: tasks_list_calendars
tools.title: Listar calendarios de tareas
tools.description: List your own and shared calendars supporting tasks (VTODO).

tools.name: tasks_list_tasks
tools.title: Listar tareas
tools.description: List tasks, including undated tasks, in one visible task calendar, optionally only those with a category or only the subtasks of one task.

tools.name: tasks_read_task
tools.title: Leer tarea
tools.description: Read a task by its UID in a visible task calendar.

modules.title: Deck
notes: A card is addressed by three ids: deck_list_boards gives the board, deck_list_stacks the lists of a board, and deck_list_cards the cards of a list. Read them in that order before writing anything.
deck_read_card returns the card with its comments; deck_followup_cards lists the cards that are due or overdue, per board.

A board owned by somebody else is refused on a write until the user has been asked and the call repeats with confirm_shared: true. The refusal is a normal result that says what is missing, not an error.

The caller owns a created card. Explicit assignments are checked before creation and shown in the plan. Assignment changes during creation can produce a created card with warnings; read it before retrying in Deck. deck_edit_card changes assignees with assign and unassign (lists of account IDs, at most 100 each); an account cannot be in both, accounts are checked before anything is written, and a failure midway leaves the result listing assigned, unassigned and failed.

To set up a project from scratch use one deck_create_board call: it creates the board, its lists and their first cards after a single confirmation (at most 20 lists and 100 cards). The board is open only to its owner, so share it in Deck before assigning anybody else. deck_create_stack adds a list to an existing board. deck_delete_stack and deck_delete_board work only on something empty: they refuse, saying how many cards are left, while any card (active or archived) remains, and what they delete goes to the Deck trash. A card created by somebody else right after the second count they take before finishing may go to the trash with the list or board; it is recoverable there.

duedate accepts YYYY-MM-DD (local midnight), YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS] in the account timezone, or a timestamp with Z/±HH:MM. Nonexistent local times are refused; repeated local times use the first occurrence. Output duedate remains the local date and dueAt gives the instant with the account offset, without a timezone field. overdue is based on the local day, not the time; dueBefore accepts only YYYY-MM-DD.
Older affected deadlines must be corrected manually after checking the intended date in Deck; existing stored instants are never shifted automatically.
A card description is capped at 100000 characters and a title at 255.
deck_move_card can reorder a card within its current list or move it to another list, including one on another board. Set stackId to the destination list; without order, the card goes to the end.

deck_link_card_file requires deck.edit, files.read and files.share. Its approved plan grants native read-only file access to current and future board/group/team members. It refuses unsupported sharing policies or incomplete audiences; later membership/policy changes and the final native-write race are not continuously enforced or automatically revoked.

Use deck_list_labels before incremental add/remove label edits; repeat plan_state after approval. Unlinking a visible native file association can remove another editor’s association and the access/mount it provides, including your last mount. The file itself remains; recovery may require the native Deck UI.

tools.name: deck_followup_cards
tools.title: Seguimiento de tareas de Deck

tools.name: deck_list_labels
tools.title: Listar etiquetas de Deck
tools.description: Lists the labels available on a readable Deck board, with their IDs, titles and colours. Available on Nextcloud 32 through 35 when Deck is enabled.

tools.name: deck_list_card_files
tools.title: Listar archivos de la tarjeta de Deck
tools.description: Lists only visible existing native file associations of a readable Deck card. Requires deck.read and files.read, Files resource scope, exclusion tags and native node READ. No legacy deck_file or folders, no upload, no hidden count/handle; IDs are association/share IDs distinct from fileId. All visible items ordered by attachmentId; native Card attachmentCount stays omitted. Available on Nextcloud 32 through 35. An association you cannot see is omitted and answered like a missing one. Open the card in Deck without treating that answer as proof that a hidden association exists.

tools.name: talk_list_conversations
tools.title: Listar conversaciones de Talk
tools.description: Lists the Talk conversations the authenticated user takes part in, with the number of unread messages. It changes no state: it does not mark anything as read, does not touch notifications and does not touch activity.

tools.name: talk_read_messages
tools.title: Leer mensajes de Talk
tools.description: Reads conversation messages without changing read or notification state or recording activity. Each page is ordered oldest-to-newest and includes messages plus next_before_message_id. Start without before_message_id; use the returned next_before_message_id as the exclusive before_message_id for older history. The cursor is null when no older page remains. Use a message id in reply_to to answer, and attachmentId to cite an attachment.

modules.title: Personas
notes: Before acting on a person (inviting, mentioning, messaging), when the user did not give the account ID, call users_search and confirm with the user when more than one account matches. Never invent an ID.
users_search follows the sharing settings of the administrator: it may return nobody for a partial term.

To share something with a whole group, call users_search with include_groups: true and take the ID of the row whose type is "group": a share takes it as group:<id>. Groups are not searched without that argument, and the same administrator restrictions of accounts apply to them.

tools.name: users_search
tools.title: Buscar personas
tools.description: Searches the accounts of this Nextcloud by name, account ID or e-mail and returns their account IDs (uid), display names and, when available, e-mail; every row carries a type, "user" for an account. Use it whenever you are not sure of someone's account ID. Groups are not searched by default: to also match groups, pass include_groups: true, and the group rows come back with the type "group" and the group ID, which is what a share takes as group:<id>.

contents.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Tool guide

Grants and disabled apps are already applied: what is missing from this list you cannot call. The modules available to you are files, notes, calendar, contacts, tasks, deck, talk, people.

- **Archivos** (`files`): 10 tools — Listar archivos, Buscar archivos, Ver árbol de carpetas, Leer archivo, Listar versiones del archivo, Leer versión del archivo, Ver imagen, Ver varias imágenes, Buscar imágenes, Listar recursos compartidos.
- **Notas** (`notes`): 3 tools — Listar notas, Buscar notas, Leer nota.
- **Calendario** (`calendar`): 2 tools — Listar calendarios, Listar eventos.
- **Contactos** (`contacts`): 3 tools — Listar libretas de direcciones, Buscar contactos, Leer contacto.
- **Tareas** (`tasks`): 3 tools — Listar calendarios de tareas, Listar tareas, Leer tarea.
- **Deck** (`deck`): 7 tools — Listar tableros de Deck, Listar listas de Deck, Listar tarjetas de Deck, Leer tarjeta de Deck, Seguimiento de tareas de Deck, Listar etiquetas de Deck, Listar archivos de la tarjeta de Deck.
- **Talk** (`talk`): 2 tools — Listar conversaciones de Talk, Leer mensajes de Talk.
- **Personas** (`people`): 1 tools — Buscar personas.

Call this tool again with `module` set to one of those names to get every parameter and every behaviour note of that module, or with `tool` to detail a single tool.

If source or destination is outside your personal folder, ask the user first and retry with confirm_shared.

Reports id before and after, as well as version and share counts when corresponding apps are enabled. Does not move across different storages: there Nextcloud treats it as a copy and the id changes. If source or destination is outside your personal folder, ask the user first and retry with confirm_shared.

published.title: Mover archivos en lote

Without confirm: true writes nothing and returns the full plan: what would succeed, what conflicts, what Nextcloud denies, what belongs to someone else, and which folders would be created. With confirm: true it executes in order, creates the folders beforehand and returns a batch_id to undo with files_undo_batch. An item failing midway halts the batch: items already moved remain recorded and can be undone, and unattempted items are returned as not_attempted.

Removes only empty folders that the batch itself created; a folder with content is preserved and listed in kept_dirs.

published.description: List the shares you created: with a path, your shares on that file or folder, including your public links on items you can re-share; without one, every share you created, 50 per page with offset. Each item has shareId, type (user, group, link or room), with (id and display name), permission (view, edit or custom), reshare, expires, hasPassword, url (links only; null for a folder link while files are excluded from MCP access), removable and path. published.name: files_share
published.title: Compartir archivo o carpeta
published.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Find the account or group id with users_search first (include_groups: true for groups); never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes your public link on an item you own or can re-share (view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; use custom_password for a user-chosen password. The server generates one when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one and none was supplied. Only a generated password is returned, once.

published.name: files_upload
published.title: Subir archivo nuevo
published.description: Create a NEW file of any type (docx, xlsx, pdf, image, zip) that you generated locally, without passing its content through the model. Without confirm: true it returns the plan; with confirm: true it returns uploadUrl, a single-use link valid for 15 minutes and bound to you and this path. Send the bytes with curl -sS -T /tmp/file -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "$UPLOAD_URL"; the answer carries path, size, etag and fileId. Never overwrites a file with content: an existing name is refused, so use files_checkout to replace an existing file. For a small text file use files_create. The folder must exist (files_mkdir creates it); outside your personal folder ask the user and retry with confirm_shared.

definitions.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes your public link on an item you own or can re-share (view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; use custom_password for a user-chosen password. The server generates one when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one and none was supplied. Only a generated password is returned, once.

definitions.description: Lists only visible existing native file associations of a readable Deck card. Requires deck.read and files.read, Files resource scope, exclusion tags and native node READ. All visible items ordered by attachmentId; native Card attachmentCount stays omitted. Available on Nextcloud 32 through 35. An association you cannot see is omitted and answered like a missing one.
